Irish Man Charged With Destroying U.S. Military Plane Becomes Protest Symbol

An Irish man has been charged in the U.S. with wielding an axe and using chemicals to destroy an American military plane in what supporters have described as a protest against the U.S. military. Federal prosecutors in Manhattan accused 48-year-old Daithí O’Corrain of damaging a $60 million U.S. Air National Guard aircraft while it was parked at Ireland’s Shannon airport in April.
